rules.control: Before requesting Buffer metrics, read the local Buffer unavailable checkpoint. When it identifies an active Buffer cooldown, make no API call and write the same-date unavailable snapshot with failureClass rate_limited and only the safe retryAt timestamp as deferredUntil.
rules.verification: Focused snapshot tests verify active cooldown recognition and expiry handling without retaining the raw rate-limit reason. Full profit:test is required before review.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable cooldowns if the control skips an eligible request, omits or duplicates a checkpoint, exposes sensitive data, records an incorrect cooldown timestamp, or changes Buffer publishing behavior.

rules.expectedProfitMechanism: Making cached metric age explicit prevents stale performance observations from driving current-day creative or distribution decisions, reducing avoidable rework while Buffer evidence is unavailable.
rules.baseline: At the September 7 review, the newest valid Buffer snapshot was 303.26 hours old but the fitness artifact exposed only its capture timestamp.
rules.comparisonWindow: Three cooldown-bound daily reviews using cached evidence, evaluated for an exact nonnegative age label and zero claims that stale data is same-day performance.
rules.leadingMetric: Every generated fitness report records snapshot capture time plus ageHoursAtReport and ageDaysAtReport; no cached report is labeled current-day evidence.
rules.laggingMetric: More reliable matched creative decisions, then qualified visits, leads, conversions, revenue, and gross profit when authoritative evidence becomes available.
guardrails: Do not substitute prior-date metrics for a missing same-date snapshot.
Do not treat unavailable metrics as zero or permit stale rankings to promote a creative change.
Do not change Buffer request, release QA, rights, media-readback, attribution, scheduling, or publishing behavior.
rules.control: Fitness reports calculate and display the valid source snapshot age at report generation. During a provider cooldown, cached reports are historical ranking evidence only and retain their true age.
rules.verification: The focused fitness regression test passes with an injected report time and verifies a 48-hour, 2-day age label. The September 7 report records the August 26 snapshot at 303.26 hours, or 12.64 days.
rules.rollbackCondition: Retire or revise after three comparable reviews if age is inaccurate, absent, negative, or enables a stale snapshot to be treated as same-day or selection evidence.
